summary: Neil joins the More Future host for a portfolio and AI-infrastructure discussion. Key disclosure: Neil trimmed his AMD position by 23% (consistent with his Sep 27 own-channel SELL/trim call) and bought 43 shares of Broadcom the same day at ~$353 — reiterating his AVGO BUY ('almost as if I'm seeing money on the table'). The pair debate Oracle vs Nebius/CoreWeave: Neil argues shorts are targeting the wrong names — Nebius is executing (diversified 20-50MW sites) while Oracle's mega-centers (e.g. 2.5GW 'Project Jupiter' in New Mexico) face permitting risk and CoreWeave can't delay interest payments; he prefers Nebius but gives no explicit buy call on NBIS or ORCL. Other topics: Nvidia's forward P/E near historic lows (~15-16x vs ~31x traditional) with >$400B FCF expected in FY29; Meta's audio-only Ray-Ban glasses (he plans to buy); holding extra cash into 2027 given macro uncertainty. No new explicit calls and no stance flips for Couch Investor.
